SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 776460
DOCKET NO. F00638623
PLAINTIFF – TOWD POINT MORTGAGE TRUST 2020-4, U.S. BANK NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, AS INDENTURE TRUSTEE
DEFENDANTS- DOUGLAS MICHAEL SOLVESEN; ET ALS
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday The 2nd Day of December 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the TOWNSHIP of WOODBRIDGE, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 63 BLOCK 578.10 FKA BLOCK 578J
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
400 W PROSPECT AVENUE
WOODBRIDGE, NEW JERSEY 07095
LOT 63 BLOCK 578.10 FKA LOT 63 BLOCK 578J
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
MUNICIPALITY: Township of Woodbridge
COUNTY AND STATE: County of Middlesex, State of New Jersey
STREET & STREET NUMBER: 400w Prospect Ave, Township of Woodbridge, NJ 07095
TAX LOT AND BLOCK NUMBERS: Lot: 63; Block: 578.10 FKA Block 578J Lot:63
DIMENSIONS: Approximately: 75X90
UPSET PRICE: Approximately: $162,658.56 and any additional sums as ordered by the court.
OCCUPANCY STATUS: Unknown
NEAREST CROSS STREET: Terrace Avenue
Beginning at a point at the intersection of the westerly sideline of Terrace Avenue (50 feet wide) and the northerly sideline of West Prospect Avenue (60 feet wide) and from said beginning point running thence f/k/a Block 578J Lot:63 (This concise description does not constitute a legal description. A copy of the full legal description can be found at the Office of the Sheriff.)
Pursuant to a tax search of 08/18/2026; 2026 Qtr. 4 Due: 11/01/2026 $1,942.94 OPEN Sewer: Woodbridge Twp 1 Main Street Woodbridge, NJ 07095 732-602-6010 Acct: 82172900 0 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026 $198.06 OPEN AND DUE 10/01/2026 $197.49 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS Sewer charges are based on prior water consumption Water: PRIVATE - Middlesex Water Company P.O. BOX 826538 Philadelphia, PA 19182-6538 800-549-3802
THE SHERIFF RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerk’s Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remains of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $129,345.63 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration, are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: October 27, 2026
FRENKEL, LAMBERT, WEISS, WEISMAN & GORDON LLP
53 GIBSON STREET
BAY SHORE, NY 11706
(973) 325-8800
